description: A storm: a broad dark deck over the whole of it, and towers rising through it in a spiral toward its centre. Places and radii are shares of the system's size; heights shares of its height above its base as it stands now. A layer grows as the cloud strength goes from grow's first to its second; tone runs from the dark base (0) to the white top (1). A spiral's along is its inner and outer radius, across how many turns it winds.
